sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Phones and tablets: Sticky Page Headers no longer squeezes the MusicBrainz header, the entity header with its buttons, the tabs and every section bar into a narrow column. A phone shows the wide table zoomed out, and the bars were sized to the unzoomed screen width. On a touch device the feature is now off by default. Opted in, the bars are sized to the zoomed-out view. Desktop browsers are unchanged.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: New setting "Sticky Page Headers on touch devices" (📌 Table stickiness), off by default. It turns Sticky Page Headers on for a phone or tablet. Pinch-zoom moves the visible area independently of what the browser pins, so the bars cannot reliably stay in view there.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Help: new section "On a phone or tablet".

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Phones and tablets: tapping an action button no longer leaves its rich tooltip stuck on the page after the table has rendered. A tap now opens no hover tooltip at all: not the action buttons' tooltip, the artwork preview and its type tooltip, the big-image tooltips or the Relationships tooltips. Nothing could close them again until something else was tapped. Mouse hover is unchanged.
